# atlas-cold-chain-monitor

Temperature monitoring for the refrigerated vans planned for **Project Atlas**.

Two grocery retailers in Porto asked for temperature-controlled delivery. This repository sketches how van sensors would report readings every five minutes and alert the driver if a load goes above 5 °C. **Maria Lopez** is comparing the cost of leasing versus buying the vans.
